Quality score: 6/10.

The code is readable and reasonably modular for a research/demo package, and the unit tests pass after installing dependencies: `30 passed, 1 skipped, 5 deselected`. I would not approve it as-is. The clean-checkout workflow is broken around story data generation, runtime artifact validation is weak, and several input/config edge cases can silently corrupt results or fail late.

Estimated rewrite/significant-change scope: about 250 LOC, mostly CLI/data workflow hardening, config validation, artifact schema checks, safer generation/network handling, and tests for those paths.

issues.description: Default config points at data/stories, but the repo does not include that required dataset so extract/all cannot run from a clean checkout.
generate-stories requires data/stories/manifest.json before it can generate stories, making the documented bootstrap path fail.
The CLI loads the 2B model before validating stage preconditions, so missing local inputs surface only after expensive download/auth/device work.
load_vectors trusts cached manifest and arrays without validating model, scale, emotion order, dimensions, or layer bounds.
Emotion names are joined directly into filesystem paths, allowing path traversal if config or manifest values are untrusted.
Emotion names from artifacts are interpolated directly into output filenames, allowing unsafe paths and invalid filenames.
External story-generation HTTP calls have no timeout, retry, or status/error handling and can hang indefinitely.
Story generation overwrites files non-atomically and can leave a partially mixed dataset after any mid-run failure.
Config loading performs no schema or range validation for layer fractions, PCA target, counts, dtype, or device.
mean_activations divides by zero for one-token inputs because effective_start can equal sequence length.
all_token_activations can concatenate an empty token set when neutral transcripts are empty or only special tokens.
span_mean_activations silently returns zero vectors when required spans match no tokens, corrupting downstream correlations.
emotion_vectors returns NaNs when any emotion has no labeled examples instead of failing clearly.
pca_components divides by zero and returns NaNs on zero-variance input.
Steered-emotion selection is not validated and can duplicate emotions when n_steered_emotions exceeds the available set.
Dependencies are broad lower bounds with no lockfile, making runs non-reproducible and allowing future major API breaks.
requirements.txt duplicates pyproject dependencies and includes pytest as a general install dependency, creating drift risk.
The story dataset test skips when data is absent, so the default suite passes even though the default extraction input is missing.
The only end-to-end test depends on a gated external model and is deselected by default, leaving the real pipeline mostly unverified in normal test runs.
